[ שָֽׂהֲדוּ ] noun feminine testimony (√ שְׂהַד = סְהַד ᵑ7 testify , Syriac , Arabic testify , compare Biblical Hebrew [ שָׂהֵד ] (once, as loan-word) K Aramaic 86 ; Egyptian Aramaic plural שהדיאֹ witnesses Cooke 404 S-C A. 15 + often); — emphatic שָֽׂהֲדוּתָא Gen 31:47 (|| Biblical Hebrew עֵד ).
